text: This is a great app. It has a nice, intuitive design, which really stands out, and it is even cross-platform. However, I think it's better to have a few more essential features that other apps have. (a) Widgets and (b) options to set more flexible schedules (e.g., 2 days in a week) are currently missing. For these reasons, I'm currently moving to another app called habithub. But I like the UI so much, so I will come back once the aforementioned functions are implemented. (I am willing to pay.)
